summary: Universal Logistics Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that on September 29, 2026 certain subsidiaries amended their Credit and Security Agreement with KeyBank as administrative agent. The Fourth Amendment extends the revolver maturity from September 30, 2027 to September 30, 2029, cuts aggregate revolving commitments from $500.0 million to $350.0 million, and resets an uncommitted accordion permitting up to $150.0 million of additional commitments. Pricing grids and commitment fees were revised; leverage and fixed-charge coverage covenants remain. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch covenant headroom and reduced liquidity.
